name: Social, reproductive and drug-reward behavior and learning
rationale: Members are organism-level behaviors (parental, aggressive, mating, drinking), learning (operant, nonassociative, place preference) and cocaine/ethanol responses, lacking the neuropeptide, sleep, dopamine-receptor and exploration signaling of the confusables.

qualifier: proliferation, survival and differentiation in thymus
name: Thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation in thymus
rationale: All members regulate immature T cell proliferation, apoptosis or differentiation within the thymus, unlike confusables centred on peripheral T cell activation, bone marrow or kidney cell proliferation.

name: Ribosome biogenesis control: MYC targets and rDNA silencing
rationale: Members concern growth-linked control of ribosome production (MYC target sets, ribosome biogenesis regulation, methionine sensing) and repression of rRNA genes (SIRT1, Pol I repression, nucleolar chromatin), whereas confusables hold the Pol I transcription machinery and rRNA processing steps.

qualifier: protein import; very-long-chain and ether lipids
name: Peroxisome protein import and very-long-chain/ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal protein targeting, import and fission plus anabolic lipid routes (VLCFA elongation, plasmalogen/ether and wax synthesis, ALA/LA metabolism), while confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid beta/alpha-oxidation.

core: Cellular cholesterol uptake, storage and efflux
name: Macrophage foam cell cholesterol uptake, storage and efflux
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol import, storage, efflux and foam cell differentiation in response to oxidised LDL and LXR, distinct from confusables on HDL assembly/clearance, phospholipid catabolism and pinocytosis.

qualifier: taste, smell, pain and thermosensation; TRP and K2P channels
name: Taste, smell, pain and thermosensation with TRP and K2P channels
rationale: Members are chemosensory (taste, olfaction, pheromone), nociceptive, itch and thermal perception plus TRP and tandem-pore K+ channels, whereas confusables are dominated by resting-potential K2P or tachykinin signaling without chemosensation.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and endothelial extravasation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, diapedesis and T cell/neutrophil extravasation, unlike confusables on monocyte activation, chemokine signaling or T cell immunological synapse.

name: Cellular zinc import, efflux and homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns zinc influx, efflux, compartmentalization or zinc starvation response, whereas confusables concern copper, manganese, iron or cadmium handling.

name: Erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are EPO or TPO receptor signaling and its RAS, PI3K, PLCG and STAT5 branches, distinct from growth hormone/prolactin, FLT3/PDGFR and generic PI3K confusables.

name: Inositol phosphate signaling and PTEN-mediated PI3K/AKT restraint
rationale: Members combine nuclear inositol/pyrophosphate synthesis and PI5P signaling with PTEN control (ceRNAs, loss of function) and negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF1R, while confusables emphasise AKT targets and PTEN stability or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

name: Oxidative phosphorylation control and ROS-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, OXPHOS, ATP synthesis and ROS production together with hydrogen peroxide/hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis, which the confusables split apart or lack.

name: Actin filament severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: All three members concern breaking down or capping actin filaments, while confusables concern actin polymerization, protrusions, crosslinking or contraction.

name: Canonical Wnt receptor-proximal signaling and DVL/AXIN turnover
rationale: Members act at FZD/LRP5 receptors, ligand antagonists, DVL activation and AXIN/DVL degradation, unlike confusables on Wnt secretion, non-canonical calcium signaling or TCF/beta-catenin transcription.

qualifier: mature mRNA through the nuclear pore
name: Mature mRNA export through the nuclear pore
rationale: Members are transport of mature (spliced, intronless, SLBP-dependent/independent) mRNAs and RNA export through nuclear pores, distinct from confusables on histone mRNA processing, mRNA decay or pore assembly and ribosome export.

name: Synaptic vesicle clustering, transmitter uptake and synapse structure
rationale: Members tune synaptic structure and output (presynaptic cytoskeleton, vesicle clustering, spontaneous transmission, transmitter uptake/secretion, dendrite extension, receptor retention) without the clathrin vesicle recycling or exocytosis-cycle machinery of the confusables.

name: Fatty acid-sensing PPARA transcription and mitochondrial biogenesis
rationale: Members link fatty acid sensing to PPARA-driven gene expression and mitochondrial biogenesis, unlike confusables on PPARG adipogenesis, LXR lipogenesis or fatty acid transport/oxidation.

name: Vitamin D activation and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members are vitamin D hydroxylation (CYP27B1/CYP24A1 defects) and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors, which confusables (retinoids, phosphate and mineralization) lack.

qualifier: corticosteroids and sex steroids via P450 enzymes
name: Cytochrome P450 steroidogenesis of corticosteroids and sex steroids
rationale: Members span pregnenolone, glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis with their CYP enzyme defects, whereas confusables are corticosteroid secretion control or vitamin D/retinoid P450s.

name: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
rationale: Members are E2F target sets and networks, G1/S-specific transcription and proliferation modules, distinct from G2/M checkpoint and DNA replication initiation confusables.

core: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix maturation
name: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix crosslinking and turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C/E metabolism and dehydroascorbate transport with oxidative matrix steps (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane, hyaluronan and proteoglycan turnover), absent from the iron, ROS, vitamin K and BH4 confusables.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol membrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, while confusables center on cationic amino acid and oligopeptide transport.

name: Stress- and oncogene-induced senescence and SASP
rationale: Members are senescence induction by oxidative stress and oncogenes, the secretory phenotype, G0 arrest and Polycomb-linked repression, unlike confusables on heterochromatin foci, UV response or cancer evasion of senescence.

name: Amyloid-beta production and glial activation in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members regulate APP synthesis/processing, amyloid-beta formation and clearance, tangles and microglial/astrocyte activation, proliferation and survival, while confusables are amyloid fibril formation and clearance without glial control.

name: TRiC chaperonin cytoskeletal folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members are prefoldin/TRiC folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, distinct from confusables on general, ER or stress chaperone folding.

name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water balance and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover vasopressin signaling, aquaporin water reabsorption, osmotic and salt stress responses and renal sodium/chloride handling, unlike confusables on cation-chloride cotransporters or renin-angiotensin and natriuresis.
